tagline: Starting in January 2027, ai forecast version 2 will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
what_it_does: Starting in January 2027, ai forecast version 2 will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. ai forecast version 2 uses a foundation model for more accurate time series forecasts in SQL, and adds holidays, external covariates, and non negative forecasts. Queries that don't specify a version continue to use version 1.
